sentences.quote: Young-Way Liu (born 1956) is a Taiwanese business executive who serves as the chairman and president of Foxconn (Hon Hai Precision Industry). He was appointed to the position in 2019 following the retirement of the company's founder, Terry Gou.
sentences.text: Liu Young-Way, known as Young Liu, born in 1956, was appointed chairman and chief executive officer of Hon Hai Technology Group (Foxconn) in 2019, succeeding founder Terry Gou.

sentences.quote: Mr. Liu founded three companies: a motherboard company, Young Micro Systems in 1988; a northbridge and southbridge IC design company focused on the PC chipset, ITE Tech in 1995; and an ADSL IC design company, ITeX in 1997. Young Micro Systems was merged with Foxconn in 1994, and ITeX successfully listed on NASDAQ in 2001.
sentences.text: An entrepreneur with over four decades in electronics, he founded motherboard maker Young Micro Systems in 1988, chipset design firm ITE Tech in 1995 and ADSL chip firm ITeX in 1997; Young Micro Systems merged with Foxconn in 1994 and ITeX listed on NASDAQ in 2001.

sentences.quote: Mr. Liu joined Foxconn in 2007 as Special Assistant to the Founder. In 2010, he was appointed as General Manager of the Innovation Digital System Business Group of Foxconn and later became the Chairman of Socle Technology Corp in 2014.
sentences.text: He joined Foxconn in 2007 as special assistant to the founder, became general manager of its Innovation Digital System Business Group in 2010, chairman of Socle Technology in 2014, and set up and led the Semiconductor Business Group in 2016.

mgmt_bio.text: Liu Young-Way, known as Young Liu, born in 1956, was appointed chairman and chief executive officer of Hon Hai Technology Group (Foxconn) in 2019, succeeding founder Terry Gou. An entrepreneur with over four decades in electronics, he founded motherboard maker Young Micro Systems in 1988, chipset design firm ITE Tech in 1995 and ADSL chip firm ITeX in 1997; Young Micro Systems merged with Foxconn in 1994 and ITeX listed on NASDAQ in 2001. He joined Foxconn in 2007 as special assistant to the founder, became general manager of its Innovation Digital System Business Group in 2010, chairman of Socle Technology in 2014, and set up and led the Semiconductor Business Group in 2016.
